en.description:
Watch Games — a pixel arcade on your wrist

No phone nearby? Between swim sets, on the commute, or in a short queue—lift your wrist and play. Watch Games is built for Apple Watch: retro pixel style, simple controls, perfect for spare moments, and it can run on the watch by itself.

【Why it fits the watch】
• Short rounds: most games take seconds to a few minutes
• Simple controls: swipe, tap, and directions—easy with a watch
• Play independently: no need to keep staring at your iPhone
• iPhone companion: records, Traveler sync, and some games on phone

【Featured games】
• Mega Maze: huge maze, fog of war, joystick move—race your distance
• Traveler: feed your pixel companion, travel & city sights; phone ↔ watch sync
• Life Sim: peek into a day-in-the-life slice
• Tetris (4-Way), Coin War, Gun Rush, Pixel Link
• Parking Exit, Screw Relax, Pool, Bottle Match
• Coffee Master, One Tea, Sushi Belt, Plot Grow
• Slice Master, Face Vent, Fever Spin, Spit Aim, Mouth Toss
• Punch SFX: playful punch gestures and sounds

【On iPhone】
• Browse every game and your local records
• Continue Traveler, Mega Maze, Plot Grow and more on phone
• Game Center friend leaderboards for supported games

Lift your wrist. Start a pixel round.
en.releaseNotes:
• New Mega Maze: huge map, fog of war, virtual joystick, and full-map preview
• Traveler on iPhone: cleaner layout and improved room/scene display
• Game Center: friend leaderboards for supported games
• Fixes for display and stability

zh.description:
Watch Games —— 戴在手腕上的像素游戏厅

没带手机？游泳组间休息、通勤路上、排队片刻，抬起手腕就能开一局。Watch Games 专为 Apple Watch 设计，像素复古风格，操作简洁，适合碎片时间畅玩，并可在手表上独立运行。

【为什么适合手表】
• 一局很短：多数玩法几十秒到几分钟，随时可停
• 操作克制：滑动、点按、方向键，戴着手表也好上手
• 独立运行：不必一直盯着手机
• 手机伴侣：查看记录、同步旅行家，部分玩法可在 iPhone 游玩

【热门玩法】
• 巨型迷宫：超大迷宫、迷雾探索、摇杆移动，通关比拼路程
• 旅行家：像素旅伴喂养、出行与城市观光，手机与手表同步
• 现实模拟器：观察一天节奏里的生活切片
• 俄罗斯方块（四向版）、零用钱大战、火力冲刺、像素连连
• 停车场出车、螺丝解压、桌球、饮料对对碰
• 咖啡大师、一盏茶、寿司传送带、腕上田
• 分割大师、出气脸、狂热转、吐准了、投进嘴
• 出拳音效：挥拳互动与趣味音效

【手机端能做什么】
• 浏览全部游戏介绍与本地成绩
• 旅行家、巨型迷宫、腕上田等可在手机继续体验
• 支持 Game Center 好友排行榜（对应玩法）

抬起手腕，开一局像素小游戏吧。
zh.releaseNotes:
• 新增「巨型迷宫」：超大地图、迷雾探索、虚拟摇杆与全图预览
• 「旅行家」手机端体验优化：场景贴合、界面更清爽
• 接入 Game Center：多款游戏支持好友排行榜
• 修复若干显示与稳定性问题

versionHistory.releaseNotes:
• New games
Coffee Master — grind, steam, and pour on your wrist café bar
One Tea — pour, time, and taste the tea rhythm
Plot Grow — plant and water a tiny farm on your watch
Mouth Toss — aim and toss food right into the mouth
Spit Aim — time your spit and hit the target
• New languages
Now supports Simplified Chinese, English, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, Arabic, Russian, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Italian, Bengali, Turkish, and Hindi. Switch anytime in Settings.

Four new games
• Slice Master: Cut produce close to the ordered weight
• Face Vent: Tap to vent—combos stack the faces
• Traveler: Wrist pet goes on trips; care syncs phone ↔ Watch
• Fever Spin: Place a bet and pull the lever

• New Mega Maze: huge map, fog of war, virtual joystick, and full-map preview
• Traveler on iPhone: cleaner layout and improved room/scene display
• Game Center: friend leaderboards for supported games
• Fixes for display and stability
